---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible non-sensitive build or runtime defect
title: "[Bug] "
---

You do not need to understand XNU internals to report a problem. Please provide the details you know; mark unknown items as unknown. This is research software, not a supported installer.

## Environment

Project commit, XNU pin, architecture, host kernel, CPU model, toolchain and execution mode (standalone TCG, standalone KVM, hosted or physical hosted).

## Expected behavior

## Observed behavior

Last verified boundary, error and exit status. Distinguish kernel and verifier failures.

## Reproduction

Minimal steps and sanitized relevant output.

## Additional context

Regression range, related reports and untested assumptions.

Do not include sensitive memory dumps, credentials or proprietary images. Security-sensitive reports belong in the private reporting process described in SECURITY.md.
